properties.name: HSWM
properties.user_utterance: HWAF 는 폐기하고 “승인된 정본 원자마다 책임 owner가 하나”라는 schema-relative 유일성뿐입니 이거로 생각해서 좀더 과학 철학에 입거해서 HSWM 사고 연구를 진행해줘봐봐 ㅇㅇ
properties.definition: HSWM is a persistent token-native living harness and world model: LLM-interpreted and generated token streams activate LLM-executed transitions over schema-admitted canonical atoms and typed relations. The evolving hypergraph is its persistent body and world model; outcome-bound continuous learning changes relations, transition dispositions and subsequent behavior. The fixed H/W/A/F/Pi decomposition was retired by the 2026-08-26 user source. Each admitted canonical atom has one schema-relative responsibility owner. This is target identity, not demonstrated efficacy.
properties.user_canon: HSWM은 token stream으로 활성화되는 LLM-executed transition이 schema가 승인한 canonical atom과 typed relation 위에서 작동하는 지속적 living harness이자 world model이다. 고정 H/W/A/F 분해는 폐기되었으며 승인된 정본 원자마다 schema-relative 책임 owner가 하나다. 효능을 입증했다는 주장은 아니다.
properties.classification_basis: DESIGN/AI classifies the source-defined target; existing concept authority and canonical scope are preserved, and the summaries are explicitly secondary interpretations.
